text:
maria_cs: Quick check — AuroraFold cutover planned for Tue 09:00 UTC. Final gating questions: KMS key rotation window, egress firewall exception for Splunk, and audit log retention TTL. Need any blockers from infra before we confirm? cc @lina_infra @tasha_eng
jake_se: Looking good from CS side, customer asking for a 2-hour KMS rotation window with a rollback plan. Do we support hot-rollover?
tasha_eng: We support double-key step: primary/standby approach. For a hot rollover we need a short maintenance window (~15-30m) to update creds on dedicated nodes. 2h is fine but can be reduced. Need to confirm with Lina on Splunk egress path.
lina_infra: Splunk egress is allowed via NAT GW in prod-vpc-us-east-1, port 443 to splunk.collector.redwood-splunk.com. Need customer to whitelist our NAT IPs or configure VPC peering. Also audit logs: default retention 90 days, can extend to 365 for enterprise plan (billing note).
sam_re: Customer is on enterprise plan; they'd like 180d retention. Can we set TTL to 180 and export to their S3? They prefer retaining in their bucket for compliance.
tasha_eng: Yes — we can configure audit export to customer S3 with kinesis delivery. We'll need a cross-account IAM role from them with s3:PutObject and kms:Encrypt if they want SSE-KMS.
maria_cs: Action items: 1) Lina to provide NAT IP list and Splunk hostnames, 2) Eng to confirm exact KMS rollover steps and estimated outage, 3) Customer to provide cross-account role ARN. Can we do a quick smoke on Mon 17:00 UTC?
lina_infra: I'll post IPs by EOD. NATs are ephemeral if they use autoscaling — recommend static EIP NATs we provision for them.
tasha_eng: KMS plan: create new key in their key policy (we'll coordinate), change service to include new key as alternate, rotate traffic, then schedule final cutover to new key within 20m. Rollback path is immediate switch back within 5m. I'll draft runbook.
redwood-deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: privnet-aft-smoke -> Mon 17:00 UTC by @tasha_eng. Status: pending.
sam_re: :thumbsup: I'll confirm with customer and request role ARN. Also will push for whitelist vs peering decision.
maria_cs: Potential renewal risk: customer asked if extra retention costs count toward contract — remind finance. Flagging @finance_ops for a heads-up.
lina_infra: IP list: 54.23.12.101, 54.23.12.102, 54.23.12.103. Hostnames: splunk.collector.redwood-splunk.com, splunk-2.collector.redwood-splunk.com
tasha_eng: Draft runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/aurorafold-kms-rollover — will attach to ticket.
sam_re: Customer confirmed role ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/AuroraFold-AuditExportRole
maria_cs: Great. Last check: any blockers to greenlight cutover Monday smoke? If none, we lock.
jake_se: No blockers from CS; monitor latency during smoke.
tasha_eng: No blockers from eng. I'll trigger deploy and monitor logs. plan to roll back if SSE/KMS errors > 5%.
redwood-deploy-bot: deploy started: privnet-aft-smoke — in progress
maria_cs: :confetti_ball: Thanks team — will update customer. Please post postmortem notes in thread if anything unusual.
